title: 007 First Light

ini.why: Conditional. The wiki: required for NVIDIA users to avoid crashes when overriding sharpness or using Output Scaling. The Sharpness Override step below overrides sharpness, so the condition holds. OptiScaler 0.9.3+ sets it itself only on AMD and Intel

manual: Start with path tracing and Ray Reconstruction off, then enable them one at a time. Precaution, not a fix: the only Blackwell NR report for this title (Linux, Proton) faulted on the first NR frame with Ray Reconstruction on.
DLSS inputs have forced sharpness: tune or disable it with Sharpness Override in the overlay (Insert) before judging NR.
Enable Neural Rendering in the overlay after the game has loaded.

sources.supports: RestoreComputeSignature condition on NVIDIA; forced sharpness on DLSS inputs and the Sharpness Override option (last tested 0.9.4)
Linux/Proton RTX 5060 Ti: Xid 69 on the first NR composition with DLSS Ray Reconstruction on

recheck: The wiki's 007 First Light page changes, a fork release names the title, or a Windows Blackwell report appears
